invalid_if: The powers granted are not stated with sufficient certainty for a third party to know their limits
name: Powers Granted
title: Powers Granted

legal_basis.note: An agent having authority to do an act has authority to do every lawful thing which is necessary in order to do such act
Effect of acts done by the donee of a power

authoring_note: The closing sentence is the most important in the clause. A power of attorney is construed strictly against the donee, and an ancillary sweep-up limb drafted without that express limitation invites an argument that general words enlarge the specific grant. Stating the rule in the instrument makes the position plain to a third party relying on it.
